To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
testing is still a critical aspect of Web system development, and that security must be taken into account in the early stages of the development process.

(a) the testing of Web systems requires a new testing approach that is different from the traditional testing approach; (b) security is a critical issue for Web systems and a new approach to security is required.
• Testing Web systems is still a challenging task, and the use of new techniques and tools is required to improve the quality of Web applications.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the following topics: • Web testing: testing techniques and tools for Web applications, Web services, Web sites, etc. • Web security: security techniques and tools for the protection of Web applications, Web sites, Web services, etc.

the following issues: (a) the development of new techniques for testing the Web, (b) the definition of a new quality framework for the Web, (c) the development of a Web security model and the definition of new security mechanisms.
the following issues: (1) testing Web applications, (2) Web services security and (3) Web systems security.

Web systems quality and dependabilty is a very challenging research field and that there is still much work to be done.
the quality and dependability issues of the Web systems are still open and challenging.

the papers in this special section provide a good example of how the research on Web systems quality and dependibility can be applied to the industrial practice.
testing and security are still two of the most critical issues of Web systems.
the Web is becoming a complex, heterogeneous environment where the traditional quality and dependability issues are still present, but they need new and specific solutions to be solved.

the Web is not a simple extension of traditional software, and it needs to be studied and analyzed in a specific way.

testing and security are two aspects of Web systems that are still far from being fully understood and that require a lot of research efforts in order to provide a solid theoretical foundation and a set of practical techniques and tools to support the development of high quality and dependable Web systems.
